title: Dumb Patrick
blurb: The Dumb Patrick sound — Bikini Bottom's most confidently unintelligent resident, in audio form. Patrick has spent decades being wrong with total conviction, which makes him the internet's patron saint of bad takes. Play it when someone says something so misguided it deserves a starfish's endorsement.
origin: Patrick Star's iconic dim-witted delivery from SpongeBob SquarePants.
